hook.text: An ML model analyzed 10 years of data and 200 variables to forecast demand. It beat the team's model by 25%.

buildup.text: Machine learning finds complex, non-linear patterns in large datasets that traditional methods miss.

discovery.text: Gradient boosting, neural networks, and ensemble methods can handle hundreds of demand drivers simultaneously.

twist.text: ML models are black boxes. If you can't explain why the forecast changed, stakeholders won't trust it.

climax.text: The best implementations combine ML accuracy with explainable outputs that planners can review and override.

punchline.text: ML sees patterns humans can't. But humans must still decide.

quiz.question: What is a key challenge of ML in forecasting?
options: Models are often unexplainable to stakeholders
